decision.reasoning_trace: Based on the customer's interest in Mechanical Keyboards, the consideration set was formed with products from this category. Products with higher ratings (above 4.2) were prioritized. The final choice was the ikbc W200 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard with a rating of 4.2, as it seems to meet a broad set of customer needs including both Windows and Mac compatibility, media keys, and an affordable price of $85.99.
